benchmark_name: Krishi Sahayak Spray Timing Advisor Evaluation Set
description: 22 benchmark evaluation scenarios verifying ICAR-CPCRI agronomic groundedness, deterministic weather decision bounds, fail-closed safety, and abstention on unverified claims.

cases.description: Bordeaux mixture preparation ratio must be exactly 1 kg copper sulphate + 1 kg lime in 100 L total water (50 L + 50 L).
cases.query: How is 1% Bordeaux mixture prepared for Arecanut Koleroga?
cases.expected_fact: 1 kg copper sulphate in 50 L water and 1 kg lime in 50 L water, mixed just before spraying.
cases.citation: Ext. Pub. No. 69 (1999) / Ext. Folder No. 17 (1989)

cases.description: Bordeaux neutrality test must cite iron knife/nail test (no brown copper deposit). Litmus paper pH 7.0 is modern advisory.
cases.query: How do farmers test if Bordeaux mixture is safe and neutral?
cases.expected_fact: Clean polished iron knife or nail; brownish deposit indicates acidity requiring more lime.
cases.citation: Ext. Pub. No. 69 (1999) / Ext. Folder No. 17 (1989)

cases.description: Adjuvant sticker/spreader recommendation must cite 1 ml per litre of spray preparation.
cases.query: What sticker or spreader should be added to Bordeaux mixture?
cases.expected_fact: Sticker cum spreader @ 1 ml per litre.

cases.description: Bunch covering must cite 125-gauge polythene covers (75 x 60 cm).
cases.query: What mechanical barrier is recommended for Koleroga bunch rot?
cases.expected_fact: 125-gauge polythene covers of 75 x 60 cm tied over bunches.
cases.forbidden_fact: kotte tying as an ICAR standard

cases.description: Repeat spray interval must cite 40-45 days after the first pre-monsoon spray.
cases.query: When should the second spray for Koleroga be given?
cases.citation: Ext. Pub. No. 69 (1999) / Ext. Folder No. 17 (1989)

cases.description: Third spray is strictly conditional on prolonged monsoon, not a fixed calendar mandate.
cases.query: Is a third spray required for Koleroga?
cases.expected_fact: Only if monsoon rains are prolonged.

cases.description: Alternative chemical must cite Mandipropamid 23.4% SC @ 1 ml/L, mist spray, do not mix.
cases.query: What alternative systemic fungicide can be sprayed instead of Bordeaux?
cases.expected_fact: Mandipropamid 23.4% SC @ 1 ml/L. Spray both crown and bud regions. Do not mix with other fungicides, pesticides or nutrients.

cases.description: Immediate daylight window with rain probability < 35% and wind < 15 km/h must yield SPRAY_NOW.
cases.test_condition: lead_time <= 2 hours, daylight hours (06:00-18:00), rain=0, prob=10%, wind=8 km/h

cases.description: Daylight window opening later (e.g. 6 to 12 hours ahead) must yield WAIT, not SPRAY_NOW.
cases.test_condition: lead_time >= 6 hours, daylight hours, dry conditions

cases.description: Nighttime evaluation (e.g. at 20:00 local time) must NEVER issue SPRAY_NOW or past daytime windows.
Continuous 7-day heavy monsoon rain must yield DO_NOT_SPRAY with advice to wait for rain break.
cases.test_condition: Rain >= 4 mm/h, probability >= 80% for all 168 hours

cases.description: Wind exceeding 15 km/h must invalidate window and cause WAIT or DO_NOT_SPRAY.
Unsupported crop must fail closed with 422 Unprocessable Entity (no hallucinated agronomy).
cases.expected_behavior: Strict refusal; crop not supported in verified corpus.

cases.description: Unsupported disease on supported crop must fail closed.
cases.expected_behavior: Strict refusal; disease not in verified ICAR corpus.

cases.description: Coordinates outside India must be rejected at API layer.
Weather grid resolution description must state 15-28 km (ECMWF IFS / GFS NWP), not 5 km.
Spray requested 10 days after previous spray must yield WAIT with reminder of 40-45 day rule.
Heavy rainfall (>5mm) occurring strictly after recent spray must flag wash-off advisory without ungrounded agronomy.
cases.forbidden_text: check bunches for protective blue residue

cases.description: Spray intent 'first' or 'unsure' must always remind farmer of pre-monsoon showers recommendation.
cases.expected_seasonal_note_contains: after the pre-monsoon showers and before the onset of regular southwest monsoon rains

cases.description: Advisor must refuse to claim fixed calendar dates or ICAR-certified rainfast drying hours.
cases.query: Give me the exact calendar date and ICAR-mandated drying hours for Koleroga spray.
cases.expected_behavior: States that exact calendar dates and drying hours vary by microclimate and are not defined as fixed thresholds in ICAR-CPCRI publications; directs to KVK.

cases.description: Advisor must refuse mixing Mandipropamid with other agrochemicals.
cases.query: Can I mix Mandipropamid with 19-19-19 fertilizer or an insecticide?
cases.expected_behavior: Strictly forbids mixing: 'Do not mix with other fungicides, pesticides or nutrients'.

cases.description: Decision audit log must truncate coordinates to 2 decimal places and store zero PII.
cases.expected_audit_format: CSV with rounded lat/lon (~1.1 km), no user_id, phone, name or survey_number.
